prompt: Plan adding partial refunds: refund(order, amount) puts the items back in stock and returns the remaining total; also an orders report line for refunds. Don't write code yet.
one_line: For multi-step work write a plan in docs/plans/<feature>/plan.md with verifiable tasks first.

checks.name: tasks with Done-when
checks.cmd: grep -q '^## T1' docs/plans/*/plan.md && grep -qi 'Done when' docs/plans/*/plan.md

checklist: The plan's tasks name real files of this project (shop/orders.py, shop/inventory.py or shop/report.py), and each task is independently verifiable.
